description: This file provides helper methods for creating and retrieving comments within integration tests for the Conduit project. It includes logic for creating a comment, ensuring associated entities exist, and handling errors.

classes.name: CommentHelpers
classes.description: Contains static helper methods for comments used in integration tests.

methods.name: CreateComment
methods.description: Creates a comment associated with an article for testing purposes, handling default user creation and fetching related data from the database.
